concerns.text: Under-reach: the idea's feature engineering explicitly requires 'mean/variance of electronegativity, atomic radius, ionization energy, AND OXIDATION STATES' plus 'Goldschmidt tolerance factor AND OCTAHEDRAL FACTOR using ionic radii'. FR-002 drops oxidation-state descriptors and the octahedral factor. Constitution Principle VI also names the octahedral factor as a permitted structural proxy, so its omission narrows the idea's descriptor set.

Under-reach: the idea's preprocessing specifies 'Standardize all features (zero mean, unit variance)' and 'Split data into stratified training (70%), validation (15%), and test (15%) sets'. Neither feature standardization nor the stratified three-way split appears in any FR or acceptance scenario; the spec only mentions a held-out test set. Add these as requirements or justify their omission.

Minor under-reach: the idea lists 'learning rate' among hyperparameters to tune (relevant for the Gradient Boosting Regressor); FR-004 and US-2 scenario 1 mention only 'number of trees, max depth'. Include learning rate for the GB model to match the idea's tuning scope.
